text.zh: 现存最完整的塔洛斯古典叙事见于阿波罗尼奥斯·罗迪乌斯《阿尔戈英雄纪》第四卷，而不是《伊利亚特》。
text.en: The fullest surviving classical Talos narrative appears in Book 4 of Apollonius Rhodius's Argonautica, not in the Iliad.

text.zh: 塔洛斯被描绘为守卫克里特岛的铜制自动体，是人工身体、自动运动与生命边界的早期神话想象。
text.en: Talos is depicted as a bronze automaton guarding Crete, an early mythic imagination of artificial bodies, autonomous motion and the boundary of life.
